name: fix_rec_endpoint
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,subprocess,sys
p='src/BunDomRecursion.lean';s=pathlib.Path(p).read_text().replace('(fun w => by rw [join_split hn])','(fun w => by change (if P w then 1 else 0) = if P (join (split hn w)) then 1 else 0; rw [join_split hn])').replace('  count_transport hn _','by\n  unfold stateCount\n  apply count_transport hn')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',p],input=s,text=True,check=True)
p='src/BunDomEndpoint.lean';s=pathlib.Path(p).read_text().replace('  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h)','  apply Subtype.ext\n  exact congrArg (fun w : {w : Asg n u // u ∈ sval false (stf n u u w)} => w.1) h')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',p],input=s,text=True,check=True)
